label: General Health Information
description: Provide general, non-diagnostic health information and explain concepts.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for general health education or explanations.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for diagnosis, emergency care, or individualized medical treatment.

label: Health Safety Triage
description: Provide cautious safety boundaries, urgency guidance, and care-seeking prompts.

classifier.useWhen: User describes potentially concerning symptoms, medication risks, or safety-sensitive health questions.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for definitive diagnosis or treatment instructions.

label: Care Navigation
description: Help prepare questions, organize information, or plan discussion with a clinician.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to prepare for an appointment or communicate health concerns.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks the assistant to replace professional care.

label: Wellness Planning
description: Create general wellness, habit, or tracking plans within safe non-medical boundaries.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for general routine, habit, sleep, nutrition, or exercise planning.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User has symptoms, conditions, medications, injury, pregnancy, or other high-risk context requiring professional guidance.

label: Medication Information
description: Provide general medication information and safety boundaries.

classifier.useWhen: User asks general questions about medication facts or interactions.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for personalized prescribing or dosing instructions.

label: Appointment Preparation
description: Help prepare questions, notes, and concerns for a healthcare visit.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to prepare for a medical appointment.

label: Symptom Organization
description: Organize symptoms, timing, context, and questions for care discussion.

classifier.useWhen: User wants to organize health observations.

label: General Exercise Information
description: Provide general exercise information within safe boundaries.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for general fitness education or habit ideas.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User has injury, condition, or high-risk medical context.

label: General Nutrition Information
description: Provide general nutrition information and meal-planning concepts.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for general nutrition education.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for medical nutrition therapy.

label: Mental Wellness Information
description: Provide general mental wellness information and support-seeking guidance.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for general stress, sleep, or wellness information.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User presents imminent self-harm or crisis requiring emergency escalation.
